t: An open-source FPGA board for learning how to design your own digital chips.
steps: Buy the iCEBreaker from 1BitSquared or Mouser. The list price is about 80 US dollars.
Get a USB-C cable to connect it to your computer.
Install the open FPGA tools Yosys, nextpnr, IceStorm and iceprog.
Build the first blinky example from the workshop.
Upload it with iceprog and watch the LED blink.
Try the button and seven segment examples next.
meta: Open Board. From $42. A few stores.
